pattern: shell CLI token asked in chat, not through request_secret file delivery
experience: Agents asked for API tokens in chat ('send me an API token', 'paste both ...secret-access-key=... URLs here') or promised a 'secure prompt' they never opened.
rule: For a shell CLI token, set delivery to file. Never ask for secrets in chat, and never invent one.
